Testing.title: Automated Testing
Testing.intro: I've written automated tests with Cypress, Selenium, and Robot Framework during my QA internship, in PIM's QA automation course, and in personal projects. This website is tested end to end with Cypress: the bio page, the portfolio page, every project page, and the 404 page. GitHub Actions builds the site and runs every test on each push. Click the card to watch a recorded run.
Testing.recorded: Recorded from a real run, slowed down so each step is easy to follow
